design_rationale: The design balances authority with warmth through a sophisticated navy and gold palette, conveying trust and experience while incorporating generous whitespace and refined typography that feels accessible rather than intimidating. Modern serif headings paired with clean sans-serif body text create premium professionalism, while thoughtful use of accent colors and subtle animations demonstrate the human-centered, compassionate approach to client care.

sections.name: hero
sections.layout: Split layout: left side contains headline and CTA, right side contains image. On mobile, stacks vertically with image on top.
sections.background: Solid background #f9fafb with gradient overlay on image area transitioning from #1a3a52 (left) to #f9fafb (right)
sections.image_style: Professional photograph of a confident attorney in modern office setting, warm natural lighting, shot from mid-waist up at slightly elevated angle. Alternative: Composite image showing client and attorney in consultation - warm, dignified, focused moment. Warm color temperature, no cold blues.
sections.cta_style: Primary button with secondary button below. Primary is solid gold (#d4af6a) with navy text, secondary is outlined navy with gold text. Both have smooth hover animations.

sections.name: services
sections.layout: 3-column grid on desktop (1 column mobile, 2 column tablet). Each service card contains icon, headline, description, and subtle 'Learn More' link.

card_style.hover_effect: Shadow deepens to 0 12px 24px rgba(26, 58, 82, 0.15), card lifts 4px, gold accent bar appears at top
card_style.icon_style: 60x60px icons in navy (#1a3a52), flat geometric style, centered at top of card

sections.name: about/trust
sections.layout: Left-aligned two-column layout: left column 45% contains headline and 3 paragraphs of body text, right column 45% contains 4 trust indicators stacked vertically (each with icon, number, and label)
elements: Body paragraphs explaining firm philosophy and expertise
4 trust indicator cards: Years of Experience (with number), Cases Won (with number), Client Satisfaction (with percentage), Settlements Recovered (with dollar amount in millions)
Each indicator has a small navy icon (60x60px), large bold number below in navy, smaller label text below that

sections.name: testimonials
sections.layout: Carousel or grid slider showing 3 testimonial cards at a time on desktop (1 on mobile). Cards are full-height with quote, client name, outcome/case type.

card_style.quote_style: Large gold quotation mark (48px) at top, body text in primary navy (#1a1a1a), client attribution in secondary gray below. Background is white with subtle top border in gold (4px).

sections.name: cta_banner
sections.layout: Full-width banner, centered content. Headline on top, subtext below, two buttons side-by-side on desktop (stacked on mobile)
sections.background: Solid navy background (#1a3a52) with subtle diagonal stripe pattern overlay at 5% opacity (stripe angle 45 degrees, stripe width 4px, gap 16px)
sections.button_style: Primary button: solid gold (#d4af6a) with navy text. Secondary button: solid white with navy text. Both are 1rem padding, 8px border radius, uppercase font weight 600.

sections.name: footer
sections.layout: 4-column grid layout on desktop (2 columns tablet, 1 column mobile). Columns are: About/Logo, Practice Areas, Contact Info, Newsletter signup. Bottom footer bar contains copyright and social links.
sections.background: Navy background (#0f2235) with lighter navy text (#d0d8e0). Footer bar is slightly darker (#0a1620)

button_primary.hover: Background shifts to #c9a140, shadow expands to 0 8px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18), letter-spacing increases to 0.05em

button_secondary.hover: Background color becomes #f0f4f8, border color becomes #d4af6a, text color becomes #d4af6a

mobile_adjustments: Hero section: Full-width image background with dark overlay (rgba(26, 58, 82, 0.4)), text positioned center with smaller h1 (2rem), text max-width becomes 90%, buttons stack vertically
Services grid: Single column layout, cards maintain same styling but occupy full width
About/trust section: Stacks to single column, trust indicators display in 2x2 grid instead of vertical stack
Testimonials: Display one card at a time, carousel controls visible below (dots and arrows)
CTA banner: Buttons stack vertically, full width, maintain same spacing
Footer: Single column, padding reduced to 2rem horizontal, 3rem vertical
Section padding: Reduces to padding-y: 3rem, padding-x: 1.5rem
All h1 scales to 2rem on mobile, h2 to 1.75rem, h3 to 1.375rem
Body font size remains 1rem but line-height increases to 1.7 for readability
